# 2 Chronicles Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Then said Solomon YHWH said to-dwell in-the-thick-darkness.

**2** And-I I-have-built a-house-of exaltation for-You and-a-place for-Your-dwelling forever.

**3** And-he-turned the-king his-face and-he-blessed all assembly-of Israel and-all assembly-of Israel was-standing.

**4** And-he-said blessed-be YHWH God-of Israel who spoke with-His-mouth with David my-father and-with-His-hands He-fulfilled saying

**5** from the-day that I-brought-out My-people from-land-of Egypt not I-chose a-city from-all tribes-of Israel to-build a-house to-be My-name there and-not I-chose a-man to-be leader over My-people Israel

**6** and-I-chose Jerusalem to-be My-name there and-I-chose David to-be over My-people Israel.

**7** And-it-was with heart-of David my-father to-build a-house for-name-of YHWH God-of Israel.

**8** And-he-said YHWH to-David my-father because that it-was with your-heart to-build a-house for-My-name you-did-well that it-was with your-heart

**9** only you not you-shall-build the-house but your-son the-coming-out from-your-loins he shall-build the-house for-My-name.

**10** And-He-raised-up YHWH His-word that He-spoke and-I-have-risen in-place-of David my-father and-I-sit on throne-of Israel as-that spoke YHWH and-I-have-built the-house for-name-of YHWH God-of Israel.

**11** And-I-have-placed there the-ark where is covenant-of YHWH that He-made with sons-of Israel.

**12** And-he-stood before altar-of YHWH in-front-of all assembly-of Israel and-he-spread-out his-palms.

**13** For had-made Solomon a-platform-of bronze and-he-set-it in-midst-of the-enclosure five cubits its-length and-five cubits its-width and-three cubits its-height and-he-stood upon-it and-he-knelt on his-knees in-front-of all assembly-of Israel and-he-spread-out his-palms toward-the-heavens.

**14** And-he-said YHWH God-of Israel there-is-none like-You God in-the-heavens and-on the-earth keeping the-covenant and-the-lovingkindness to-Your-servants the-walking before-You with-all their-heart

**15** who have-kept for-Your-servant David my-father that which You-spoke to-him and-You-spoke with-Your-mouth and-with-Your-hand You-fulfilled as-this day.

**16** And-now YHWH God-of Israel keep for-Your-servant David my-father that which You-spoke to-him saying not shall-be-cut-off for-you a-man from-before-Me sitting on throne-of Israel only if they-guard your-sons their-way to-walk in-My-law as-that you-have-walked before-Me.

**17** And-now YHWH God-of Israel let-be-confirmed Your-word that You-spoke to-Your-servant to-David.

**18** For truly will-dwell God with the-man on the-earth behold the-heavens and-heavens-of the-heavens not can-contain-You how-much-less this house that I-have-built.

**19** And-You-shall-turn to prayer-of Your-servant and-to his-plea YHWH my-God to-hear to the-cry and-to the-prayer that Your-servant is-praying before-You

**20** for-Your-eyes to-be open to this house day and-night to the-place that You-said to-put Your-name there to-hear to the-prayer that prays Your-servant to this place.

**21** And-You-shall-hear the-pleas-of Your-servant and-Your-people Israel that they-pray to this place and-You shall-hear from-place-of Your-dwelling from the-heavens and-You-shall-hear and-You-shall-forgive.

**22** If sins a-man against-his-neighbor and-he-takes-up on-him an-oath to-make-him-swear and-he-comes the-oath before Your-altar in-this house

**23** then-You shall-hear from the-heavens and-You-shall-act and-You-shall-judge Your-servants to-repay the-wicked to-put his-way on-his-head and-to-vindicate the-righteous to-give to-him according-to-his-righteousness.

**24** And-if is-defeated Your-people Israel before an-enemy because they-sinned against-You and-they-return and-they-confess Your-name and-they-pray and-they-plead before-You in-this house

**25** then-You shall-hear from the-heavens and-You-shall-forgive the-sin-of Your-people Israel and-You-shall-bring-them-back to the-land that You-gave to-them and-to-their-fathers.

**26** When-are-shut-up the-heavens and-there-is-no rain because they-sinned against-You and-they-pray to this place and-they-confess Your-name and-from-their-sin they-turn because You-humble-them

**27** then-You shall-hear in-the-heavens and-You-shall-forgive the-sin-of Your-servants and-Your-people Israel for You-teach-them the-good way that they-should-walk in-it and-You-shall-give rain on Your-land that You-gave to-Your-people for-an-inheritance.

**28** Famine if is in-the-land pestilence if is blight and-mildew locust and-caterpillar if is when-distresses to-him his-enemy in-land-of his-gates any plague and-any sickness

**29** any prayer any plea that is to-any man and-to-all Your-people Israel who know each-one his-plague and-his-pain and-he-spreads his-palms to this house

**30** then-You shall-hear from the-heavens the-place-of Your-dwelling and-You-shall-forgive and-You-shall-give to-each-man according-to-all his-ways whose heart You-know for You alone know the-hearts-of sons-of the-man

**31** so-that they-may-fear-You to-walk in-Your-ways all the-days that they are-living on the-face-of the-land that You-gave to-our-fathers.

**32** And-also to the-foreigner who not from-Your-people Israel is and-he-comes from-a-land far for-sake-of Your-name the-great and-Your-hand the-strong and-Your-arm the-outstretched and-they-come and-they-pray to this house

**33** then-You shall-hear from the-heavens from-the-place-of Your-dwelling and-You-shall-do according-to-all that calls the-foreigner to-You so-that they-may-know all peoples-of the-earth Your-name and-to-fear-You as-Your-people Israel and-to-know that Your-name is-called upon this house that I-have-built.

**34** When goes-out Your-people to-the-battle against his-enemies in-the-way that You-send-them and-they-pray to-You toward this city that You-have-chosen and-the-house that I-have-built for-Your-name

**35** then-You-shall-hear from the-heavens their-prayer and-their-plea and-You-shall-uphold their-cause.

**36** When they-sin against-You — for there-is-no man who not sins — and-You-are-angry with-them and-You-give-them before an-enemy and-they-take-them-captive their-captors to a-land far or near

**37** and-they-bring-back to their-heart in-the-land that they-were-taken-captive there and-they-return and-they-plead to-You in-land-of their-captivity saying we-have-sinned we-have-acted-perversely and-we-have-acted-wickedly

**38** and-they-return to-You with-all their-heart and-with-all their-soul in-land-of their-captivity where they-took-them-captive and-they-pray toward their-land that You-gave to-their-fathers and-the-city that You-chose and-to-the-house that I-built for-Your-name

**39** then-You-shall-hear from the-heavens from-the-place-of Your-dwelling their-prayer and-their-pleas and-You-shall-uphold their-cause and-You-shall-forgive Your-people who sinned against-You.

**40** Now my-God let-be please Your-eyes open and-Your-ears attentive to-prayer-of this place.

**41** And-now arise YHWH God to-Your-resting-place You and-ark-of Your-strength Your-priests YHWH God let-them-be-clothed-in salvation and-Your-faithful-ones let-them-rejoice in-goodness.

**42** YHWH God do-not turn-away face-of Your-anointed remember the-lovingkindnesses-of David Your-servant.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **6:13**: platform-of bronze — Unique to Chronicles. Kings omits the bronze platform, but the Chronicler adds this detail to explain how Solomon prayed publicly before the assembly.

- **6:18**: will-dwell God with the-man on the-earth — Solomon's deepest theological question. The temple is built on a paradox: the God who cannot be contained consents to dwell.

- **6:36**: there-is-no man who not sins — Universal human sinfulness stated as fact. The entire prayer structure assumes that sin and restoration form an ongoing cycle.

- **6:42**: lovingkindnesses-of David — Hebrew chasdei David. The prayer closes by invoking the Davidic covenant, tying the temple's efficacy to God's promises to the dynasty.


— EMET
